internal.recipe: two fresh kernels per primary evaluation template of the registered recipe (seed retry hash with the namespace); kernels distinct from every opened cohort and from cohort 7; no deterministic controls

colosseum.source: Colosseum (Conserva & Rauber 2022), authors' sample_mdp_parameters, repo 981b344, continuous setting, mean rewards
colosseum.exclusion: every kernel of the exploratory (seed 2026) and confirmatory (seed 2027) runs
colosseum.selection: first 18 per family passing the filter, sampler order

data.target: first complete suffix with >=8/10 seeds normalized return >=0.95; else >x50
data.expectile: team's documented IQL expectile fallback, counted, used only where the archived code raises

forecaster.meta_training: the sealed seven-cohort panel of cohort 7 (720 MDPs, 10,800 rows), unchanged
forecaster.procedure: oeh_final_forecast.matched_forecast for every fitted field set; XGBoost-CF as published_survival_120_*

oeh_2t.rule: w * [(1-p6) * P(k | finite; OEH 108 fields fitted on finite meta rows), p6] + (1-w) * OEH current; p6 from OEH current

comparators.xgboost_cf_18: adapted published XGBoost-CF survival model on B2 statistics
comparators.prior_oeh_matched: B2 + legacy OEH3/LCOEH4 and context (no posterior)
comparators.lce_raw: learning-curve extrapolation from posterior prefix success, no meta-training
comparators.b2_plus_cb: B2 + concentrability / sample-complexity quantities (Li et al. 2022), matched head
comparators.xgboost_cf_108: architecture control with the OEH inputs (descriptive)

gate.unit: MDP; integrated Brier (six thresholds) and seven-class log loss (1e-12 floor), averaged within MDP
gate.rule: each step: max-t simultaneous one-sided 95% lower bounds of the absolute improvement, all > 0

bootstrap.rule: max-t with the original standard error (run_oeh_120_unseen.analyze)

gate.sequence: step 2 is tested only if step 1 is GO and step 3 only if step 2 is GO; the sequence is applied to each panel separately; a closed step is reported descriptively and labelled
gate.step3_reading: a candidate replaces OEH current on a panel only if both of its contrasts pass
gate.sample_size: internal 168 MDPs exceeds the ~82 MDPs needed for the Colosseum log-loss effect at critical 1.9; the Colosseum tier repeats the earlier design (72)
